html: † יִבְלְעָם n.pr.loc. a city of Manasseh in West-Jordan land Jos 17:11 (JE; but יִב׳ here dub., v. BuRS 13 f.), Ju 1:27 2 K 9:27; so read also 2 K 15:10 for MT קָבָל־עָם (𝔊L ἐν Ιεβλααμ; v. Klo); = בִּלְעָם 1 Ch 6:55, q.v.; read יִבְלְעָם also in Jos 21:25 (‖ 1 Ch 6:55), for MT גַּת רִמּוֹן, 𝔊 Ιεβαθα (𝔊L after MT Γεθρεμμων), v. Di; it lay about 13 m. E. of N. from Samaria, three-fifths of the way to Jezreel; mod. ruin Belʿame BdPal. 228, cf. Schultz ZMG iii. 49; (Old Egyptian Y-b-ra-ʿa-mu̥ WMM 195).
